label: The distributed RLGC model
subgoals: Write series and shunt elements per unit length for a short section
Combine KVL and KCL into the wave equation for a lossless line
Compute the delay as the square root of total L times total C

label: Characteristic impedance and wave velocity
subgoals: Take the square root of L prime over C prime for Z0
Take one over the square root of their product for the velocity
Convert the velocity into millimetres per nanosecond

label: Effective dielectric constant
subgoals: Multiply c squared by L prime and C prime
Compare the result with the substrate's relative permittivity
Flag any value below one as unphysical
